암사동성당 WYD 2027 홈스테이 호스트 가정 대림 4주간 집중 모집(: Amsa-dong Parish WYD 2027 is looking for homestay host families during a four-week Advent drive (11.28–12.24) — sign up after Mass or with a form at the parish office. Homestay Aug 2–8, 2027; requirements, schedule, assignment principles and FAQ.
홈스테이 호스트 가정 모집 | 암사동성당 WYD 2027: Homestay Host Families | Amsa-dong Parish WYD 2027
대림 4주간(11.28~12.24) 홈스테이 호스트 가정을 집중 모집합니: During the four weeks of Advent (11.28–12.24) we are looking for homestay host families. A homestay is more than a bed: it is hospitality that shares faith and daily life with pilgrims from around the world. No special facilities or perfect home are needed — a simple place to sleep and a light breakfast are enough.
WYD 홈스테이 가정, 대림 4주간 집중 모집 중!: WYD homestay families wanted — four-week Advent drive!
대림 제1주일 특전미사(11.28) ~ 성탄(12.24): Vigil Mass of the First Sunday of Advent (11.28) – Christmas Eve (12.24)
토요 특전미사 ~ 주일 18시 청년미사 (새벽미사 제외) 미사 후 성당에: After Masses from the Saturday vigil to the Sunday 6 pm young adult Mass (except early-morning Mass)
본당 사무실에 신청서 비치 — 언제든 받아 가실 수 있습니다: Application forms are available at the parish office at any time
2027년 8월 2일(월) ~ 8일(일) · 8월 9일(월) 아침 식사: Monday, August 2 – Sunday, August 8, 2027 · farewell after breakfast on Monday, August 9
모집 마감 후 본당 신부님이 검토해 최종 선정, 선정 가정은 사전 모임에: After sign-ups close, the pastor reviews and makes the final selection; selected families are briefed at a preparatory meeting
“예수님을 모시듯 순례자를 맞이해 주세요!”: “Welcome pilgrims as you would welcome Jesus!”
우리 본당에 교적을 둔 가정으로 최근 3년 이내 교무금 납부와 판공성사: A household registered in our parish, with parish contributions and Easter or Christmas confession in the last three years. An adult must live in the home.
침대가 없어도 괜찮습니다. 1인당 침낭을 펴고 가방을 둘 수 있는 2m: No bed is needed. A 2 m × 1.5 m space per person for a sleeping bag and luggage is enough. Bathrooms can be shared with the family.
토스트·시리얼·우유 정도의 간단한 아침이면 충분합니다. 어려우면 사전 협: Toast, cereal and milk are plenty. If that is hard, guests can join the parish breakfast by prior arrangement.
청소년 순례자에게는 성인 인솔자가 반드시 함께하기 때문에, 한 가정에 2: Teen pilgrims always travel with an adult leader, so each home must be able to welcome two or more.
본당·행사장까지 이동: Getting to the parish and venues
도보나 대중교통으로 본당과 행사장에 갈 수 있어야 하며, 어려운 위치라면: Guests must be able to reach the parish and venues on foot or by public transport; if that is difficult, the host should be able to help.
순례자는 침낭과 개인 물품을 스스로 준비해 옵니다. 최종 호스트 가정은: Pilgrims bring their own sleeping bags and personal items. The pastor selects the final host families after reviewing applications.
After the parish welcome and orientation, meet your assigned pilgrims and take them home. Groups may arrive at different times.
간단한 아침을 드리고 본당까지 함께 이동합니다. 낮에는 순례자가 대회 일: Serve a light breakfast and go to the parish together. Pilgrims join WYD events during the day; in the evening, meet at the parish at the agreed time (around 5 pm) and go home together.
아침을 드린 뒤 배웅합니다. 순례자는 밤샘기도 후 폐막미사 장소에서 지내: Serve breakfast and see them off. Pilgrims stay at the Closing Mass venue after the Vigil, so they do not come back that night.
아침 준비는 필요 없습니다. 폐막미사 뒤(대략 오후 2~4시) 돌아온 순: No breakfast needed. When pilgrims return after the Closing Mass (around 2–4 pm), welcome them warmly so they can wash and rest.
Serve breakfast, help with packing and say goodbye.
수용 인원과 성별 등 가정의 희망을 미리 파악해, 무리하지 않는 범위에서: We ask in advance how many guests and which gender you prefer, and assign within what is comfortable for you.
남녀 공간 구분: Separate spaces for men and women
Pilgrims of different sexes in the same home do not share a sleeping space.
가능하면 같은 나라나 같은 언어권 순례자를 함께 배정해 소통의 어려움을: Where possible, pilgrims from the same country or language group are placed together to ease communication.
미성년자, 여성, 건강·이동에 도움이 필요한 순례자는 별도 기준으로 알맞: Minors, women, and pilgrims who need help with health or mobility are placed with suitable families under separate criteria.
숙박과 식사는 봉사의 마음으로 준비합니다. 첫 만남에 인사와 간단한 문화: Lodging and meals are offered in a spirit of service. A greeting, a short introduction to Korean culture and a welcome sign are nice touches for the first meeting.
알레르기 등 건강 상태를 미리 확인하고, 취침·샤워·외출 같은 생활 규칙: Check allergies and other health needs in advance, and agree on house rules such as bedtime, showers and going out.
말이 막히면 파파고·구글 번역 같은 번역 앱과 의사소통 그림 카드(AAC: When words fail, use translation apps such as Papago or Google Translate and picture communication cards (AAC).
가정과 본당 사이는 호스트가 동반합니다. 문제가 생기면 혼자 해결하지 말: Hosts accompany guests between home and the parish. If a problem comes up, don’t handle it alone — tell the parish coordinator.
가족 대표 인적 사항(성명·세례명·연락처·주소), 함께 사는 가족 구성원: Head of household details (name, baptismal name, phone, address) and household members
주거 형태, 반려동물, 가능한 언어, 원하는 성별, 가능한 인원수, 제공: Type of home, pets, languages spoken, preferred gender, number of guests, available space (e.g. 1 bed, sleeping-bag space)
홈스테이 기간(8.2~8.8), 간단한 아침 제공, 공동체가 함께하는 신: You confirm the homestay dates (8.2–8.8), a light breakfast, and that this is a faith activity shared with the community.
사례비·숙박비는 없습니다. 가정이 준비하는 것은 잠자리 공간과 간단한 아: There is no fee or payment. Families provide only sleeping space and a light breakfast; pilgrims pay for lunch, dinner and transport with a prepaid card.
서울대교구 본당은 본당마다 순례자 약 2천 명의 숙소를 맡으며, 그중 약: Each parish of the Archdiocese of Seoul will host about 2,000 pilgrims, about 500 of them in homestays. Assignments are confirmed in July 2027. Source: WYD Seoul 2027 Organizing Committee, Parish Manual (April 2026) — subject to updates.
암사동성당 호스트 FAQ에서 골라 정리: Selected from the Amsa-dong Parish host FAQ
영어를 못하는데 괜찮을까요?: I don’t speak English. Is that OK?
번역 앱과 의사소통 그림 카드(AAC)를 쓸 수 있고, 가능하면 같은 언: You can use translation apps and picture cards (AAC), and we try to place pilgrims who share a language.
My home is small and I have no spare bed.
침대가 없어도 됩니다. 순례자가 침낭·매트·세면도구를 가져오며, 1인당: No bed is needed. Pilgrims bring sleeping bags, mats and toiletries; room to lay out a sleeping bag per person is enough. Just make sure men and women don’t sleep in the same space.
I’m nervous about having strangers from abroad at home.
등록으로 신원이 확인된 순례자만 머물고, 명찰을 지니며, 한 가정에 최소: Only registered pilgrims whose identity is verified will stay; they wear name badges, and at least two stay together. Any problem is solved with the parish coordinator.
We both work, so no one is home during the day.
순례자는 낮에 대회 일정으로 나가므로 집에 있을 필요는 없습니다. 아침·: Pilgrims are out at WYD events during the day, so you don’t need to be home. Hosts accompany them to and from the parish morning and evening; if times don’t work, talk to the parish.
We’re an older couple. And we have pets.
성인이 사는 가정이면 신청할 수 있습니다. 반려동물과 주거 형태(아파트·: Any household with an adult can apply. Note pets and type of home (apartment, villa, house) on the form and we will take them into account.
다른 본당에 교적이 있어도 되나요?: Can I apply if I’m registered in another parish?
우리 본당에 교적이 있어야 하며, 최근 3년 내 교무금 납부와 판공성사: You need to be registered in our parish, with parish contributions and Easter or Christmas confession in the last three years.
Because teen pilgrims come with an adult leader.
순례자의 국적이나 성별을 고를 수 있나요?: Can I choose my guests’ nationality or gender?
국적은 고를 수 없습니다. 수용 인원, 희망 성별, 사용 언어는 신청서에: Nationality can’t be chosen. Number of guests, preferred gender and languages noted on the form are respected as far as possible. Nationality and numbers are confirmed in July 2027.
우리 본당에는 몇 명이 오나요?: How many pilgrims are coming to our parish?
본당에 약 2,000명이 오고, 그중 약 500명이 홈스테이에 머물 것으: About 2,000, of whom about 500 are expected to stay in homestays.
아침은 무엇을 드려야 하나요?: What should I serve for breakfast?
토스트·시리얼·우유 정도면 됩니다. 과일이나 삶은 달걀을 더하면 좋습니다: Toast, cereal and milk are fine; fruit or boiled eggs are a nice extra. If it’s difficult, arrange in advance for guests to use the parish breakfast.
저녁도 드려야 하나요?: Do I need to serve dinner?
No. If you like, you can share a meal such as the first evening’s dinner.
에어컨·욕실은 따로 있어야 하나요?: Do I need air conditioning or a separate bathroom?
욕실은 가족과 함께 써도 됩니다. 에어컨이 없으면 선풍기를 준비해 주세요: The bathroom can be shared with the family. Without air conditioning, please provide a fan. It helps to show guests the Wi-Fi, power outlets and where to dry laundry.
집안 규칙은 어떻게 알려 주나요?: How do I explain house rules?
첫날 취침·샤워·외출·신발·분리배출 같은 규칙을 부드럽게 알리고, 짧은: On the first day, gently explain rules such as bedtime, showers, going out, shoes and recycling; a short note in English helps.
순례자가 아프거나 문제가 생기면요?: What if a pilgrim gets sick or there’s a problem?
혼자 해결하지 말고 즉시 본당 담당자에게 알려 주세요. 병원 치료는 조직: Don’t handle it alone — tell the parish coordinator right away. Treatment must be at a hospital designated by the organizing committee for insurance to apply.
홈스테이 말고 다른 방법으로 도울 수 있나요?: Can I help in other ways besides hosting?
안내, 숙소 관리, 식사 지원, 통역, 행정 지원 봉사로 함께할 수 있습: Yes — as a volunteer for guiding, lodging, meals, interpreting or admin. Apply on the Get Involved page.
